references.text: Zipporah circumcises her son, which shows the importance of circumcision in Israel's covenant with God.
God makes a covenant with Abraham and gives circumcision as the sign of the covenant for all male descendants.
Only circumcised men could participate in the Passover meal, which underscores the significance of circumcision before entering the land.
The judgment on the generation that left Egypt – they were to die in the wilderness and not enter the promised land.
Israel's forty years in the wilderness are mentioned, the same period when circumcision was not practiced.
Stephen refers to the covenant of circumcision that God gave Abraham as background for Israel's history.
